annotations.title: Get a drug, gene or topic and its papers

description: Use this for questions about one drug, supplement, gene, process or disease: is there human evidence, has it been replicated by independent labs, in which species, which trials test it and how many posted no results, who funds it and which companies are tied to it. Takes a type and key from find_entities (intervention rapamycin). Returns the entity and its papers, newest first, with its role in each; for an intervention, gene or process, `evidence` gives its evidence as structure, never a grade. Counts are of the papers AgingResearch.News has read, not all the literature. Not for personal medical advice or doses.

cursor.description: From the last page's `pagination.next_cursor`; keep the other arguments the same.

min_relevance.description: Lowest aging-relevance score for the papers listed. Default: no filter.

name: get_entity
